name: retrieve
description: Search the HDB/HCSA knowledge base (policies, SOPs, emails, and financial/annual reports) for passages relevant to a natural-language query. Returns matching text chunks each with its source document, space, and page number for citation. Use this for any question answerable from documents rather than structured tabular data.

query.description: Natural-language query describing the information needed.

spaces.description: Optional. Restrict retrieval to these spaces (e.g. HCSA-SOPs-and-Policies, HCSA-Email-Repository, HCSA-Reports). Omit to search all spaces the caller may access.

max_results.description: Optional. Maximum number of chunks to return (default 5).
